v1_release_philosophy: Rig Relay 1.0 is a governed, local-first coding-agent desktop application for macOS. It provides a native desktop cockpit with five product surfaces (Connect, Repository Estate, Project Studio, Inference Studio, Publish Preview), multi-provider LLM agent execution, governed tool execution with evidence receipts, and local-first telemetry. It is NOT a cloud service, a fleet orchestrator, a public-page publisher, a Safari extension, or a complete local-inference platform. Those capabilities are post-v1 or deferred. v1 ships only what is production-complete, evidence-backed, and genuinely ready — no polished fake surfaces.

next_wave_recommendation.rationale: The single largest product gap is that five primary Gridline surfaces render fixture data instead of real production data. This is the most visible 'polished fake surface' in the product and violates the core release rule. Wiring production projections to the frontend is the highest-leverage improvement: it converts five surfaces from 'not ready' to 'potentially ready,' reduces the fixture-backed surface count from 5 to 0 (for v1-scoped surfaces), and enables the internal proving stages that depend on a working product surface. All distribution work (packaging, signing, notarization, Sparkle) depends on having a product surface worth distributing.
